skill.summary: Audio tagging service for environmental sound recognition. Use when user needs to identify environmental sounds in audio files (water sounds, snoring, etc.)...

latestVersion.changelog:
- Initial release of the environmental audio tagging service.
- Supports identification and classification of environmental sounds in common audio formats (mp3, wav, m4a, ogg, flac).
- Provides command-line and programmatic interfaces for audio tagging and queue status checking.
- Includes queue metrics with estimated wait time and queue state indicators (green/yellow/red).
- Troubleshooting guidance for common issues like file errors, unsupported formats, and long queue times.
